Theme

wine noun

also red wine, white wine, dry wine, sweet wine, light wine

classical

Traupman 170, 407

vīnum, vīnī n.

noun, second declension

Other words

  • vīnum rubrum — red wine

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. wine

  • vīnum sanguineum — red wine

    also used · modern · Traupman 73

  • vīnum album — white wine

    also used · classical · Traupman 73

  • vīnum austērum — dry wine

    also used · classical · Traupman 73; austērus, Cels.

  • vīnum dulce — sweet wine

    also used · classical · Traupman 73

  • vīnum tenue — light wine

    also used · classical · Traupman 73

  • vappa, vappae f. — flat, spoilt wine

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short

  • merum, merī n. — unmixed wine, wine not mixed with water

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Quint. 8.4.16: objectūrus Antōniō Cicerō merum et vomitum (Lewis & Short); Hor. Ep. 1.19.11 (Lewis & Short)

    (vōx plērumque poētica: Plaut., Hor.)

Examples

  • Pater vīnum bibit, tū aquam.

    Daddy drinks wine, you drink water.composed

  • Hoc puerīs nōn convenit.

    This isn’t for children.composed

  • objectūrus Antōniō Cicerō merum et vomitum

    Cicero, meaning to throw his drinking and his vomiting in Antony’s teethQuint. 8.4.16 (Lewis & Short)

See also wine glass, beer, strong.

SourcesLewis & Short: austerus · Lewis & Short: vappa

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. wine, wine: dry wine, wine: red wine.
